chunks: We had offered the Trust to the heavens and the earth and the mountains, but they refrained from bearing it and were frightened of it; but man took it on himself. Indeed, he is faithless and ignorant.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the Trust (Al-Amanah) offered to the heavens and earth in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the unique ontological status of humans as the vicegerents of God, bearing the 'Trust' (Al-Amanah) which encompasses both the physical cosmos and the spiritual capacity for free will. While the celestial bodies and mountains symbolically declined due to their fixed nature, humanity accepted this burden despite its inherent flaws of injustice (Zulm) and ignorance (Jahl), making it the foundation of moral accountability and the potential for divine proximity.
